data: In fiscal 2024, which ended September 28, 2024, Apple reported net sales of $391,035 million, gross profit (labeled "gross margin" in the 10-K) of $180,683 million and operating income of $123,216 million. That gives a gross margin of about 46.2% and an operating margin of about 31.5%. Both improved from fiscal 2023, when gross margin was roughly 44.1% ($169,148 million on $383,285 million of sales) and operating margin was roughly 29.8% ($114,301 million). The gain came mainly from the higher-margin Services segment, whose net sales rose to $96,169 million against $25,119 million in cost of sales.
